source.repository_purpose: Free Community-tier CSV archives generated from Coin Metrics data

observations.claim: The current public repository metadata says the repository was created in 2018, but its current default-branch head was last pushed on 2026-05-24.
A GitHub commits query on the current default branch with an until cutoff of 2026-01-01 returned no commits.
The current public repository exposes only the master branch in the branch listing checked during this research step.

inference.claim: The presently reachable default-branch history cannot serve as a weekly point-in-time revision archive for Cohort 001 across 2021-2025. A current CSV may contain historical observations, but current/revised historical values are not equivalent to evidence that the value/revision was available at each historical decision cutoff.

allowed_use: historical value use only when a separately trusted PIT availability/revision proof satisfies the frozen cutoff
prohibited_use: treating the current CSV repository state as proof of 2021-2025 point-in-time availability
using present-day revised supply/market-cap values to fill Cohort 001 missing PIT fields
weakening the 12-asset / 624-snapshot / 52-decision coverage gate because revision history is unavailable
next_source_actions: continue evaluating Coin Metrics provider-native metric status/status-time where an exact raw response can prove the value was reviewed/revised by the historical cutoff
seek other source-native or primary-document PIT evidence for supply/market-cap intervals that fail that test
persist COVERAGE_BLOCKED when no defensible PIT value exists
